title: 化学实验室技术入门

author_source: project/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/01_Introduction to Chemistry Laboratory Techniques/src.py

points.K1: 动手做，才能真正懂化学
points.K3: 写给第一次上实验课的你
points.K4: 实验技术回答哪些问题
points.K6: 课前复习萃取、色谱、蒸馏
points.K7: 先学基础，再学专门技术

shots.scene: 欣欣穿着实验服站在化学实验室里招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, wearing a lab coat, stands in a chemistry teaching lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到化学实验技术课！
overlay: 走进化学实验室：技术与安全的第一课

shots.scene: 烧杯、分液漏斗、冷凝管、色谱柱四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a beaker, a separatory funnel, a condenser and a chromatography column. No people.
shots.narration: 这一集先说说这套课讲什么。

shots.scene: 阿杰坐在书桌前，面前摊着一堆空白课本和分子模型
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a desk with a pile of blank textbooks and a ball-and-stick molecule model, scratching his head.
shots.narration: 阿杰把化学课本读了好几遍。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在实验室门口，看着满台仪器发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at a lab doorway, staring blankly at a bench full of glassware and instruments.
shots.narration: 可一进实验室，还是不知从何下手。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 别急，这套课就是为你准备的。

shots.section_title: 动手做，才能真正懂化学
shots.scene: 欣欣翻着空白书，旁边漂浮着分子球棍模型
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot leafs through a blank book while a ball-and-stick molecule model floats and rotates beside it.
shots.narration: 以前我们多在学概念和分子。
overlay: 动手做，才能真正懂化学

shots.section_title: 动手做，才能真正懂化学
shots.scene: 分子模型旋转，旁边有问号
shots.prompt_en: A red, white and black ball-and-stick molecule model rotates slowly, with a small question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 懂分子是什么、怎么变，很重要。

shots.section_title: 动手做，才能真正懂化学
shots.scene: 小研穿实验服站在实验台前，看着烧瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat stands at a lab bench looking at a flask of colored solution.
shots.narration: 但不亲手做，就谈不上真正懂化学。

shots.scene: 四个画面拼在一起：滴管滴液、记录、戴手套操作、玻璃器皿
shots.prompt_en: A four-panel split screen: a dropper adding liquid, a hand writing in a blank notebook, gloved hands adjusting an instrument, and assorted glassware. No people's faces.
shots.narration: 我们要学做化学反应。

shots.scene: 仪器屏幕上显示空白曲线图
shots.prompt_en: An analytical instrument with a screen showing a simple curve on a blank chart. No people.
shots.narration: 还要学多种分析技术。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着空白坐标图上的曲线，头顶问号变成灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The young male student studies a curve on a blank chart printout; a question mark above his head turns into a light bulb.
shots.narration: 学会读数据、解决实际问题。

shots.section_title: 写给第一次上实验课的你
shots.scene: 实验台上摆满天平、加热台和各种玻璃器皿
shots.prompt_en: A lab bench with a balance, a hot plate stirrer and assorted glassware, all with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 化学实验要用到很多专门仪器。
overlay: 写给第一次上实验课的你

shots.section_title: 写给第一次上实验课的你
shots.scene: 阿杰戴护目镜和紫色手套，在天平旁移液、记录
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wearing safety goggles and purple nitrile gloves pipettes a liquid next to a balance and writes in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 这套课主要写给第一次上实验课的人。

shots.section_title: 写给第一次上实验课的你
shots.scene: 阿杰和小研戴护目镜围在台前看一支试管，未穿实验服，小研长发披散
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student, wearing safety goggles but no lab coats, lean over a bench and look closely at one test tube; her long hair hangs loose.
shots.narration: 大学生和高年级高中生都适用。

shots.section_title: 写给第一次上实验课的你
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白实验报告，露出自信微笑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank lab report sheet and smiles with confidence.
shots.narration: 让你做实验时清楚又有把握。

shots.section_title: 实验技术回答哪些问题
shots.scene: 一瓶未知液体旁边打着问号
shots.prompt_en: A bottle of clear liquid with a blank label and a large question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么确定一种物质是什么？
overlay: 实验技术回答哪些问题

shots.section_title: 实验技术回答哪些问题
shots.scene: 两人戴护目镜在通风柜里看加热搅拌器上的烧瓶，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the older man, wearing goggles, watch a round-bottom flask on a hot plate stirrer inside a fume hood; purple question marks float nearby.
shots.narration: 怎么知道反应已经结束？

shots.section_title: 实验技术回答哪些问题
shots.scene: 密闭手套箱图标，里面是一个烧瓶，外面空气图标被挡住
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sealed glove box with a flask inside and air symbols blocked outside. No people.
shots.narration: 怕空气的化学操作又怎么做？

shots.section_title: 实验技术回答哪些问题
shots.scene: 欣欣翻开一本旧相册，里面是老式实验台的线描图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens an old album showing a line drawing of an old-fashioned chemistry bench with rows of bottles.
shots.narration: 会动手了，更能体会前辈的贡献。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着两本空白书：普通化学、有机化学
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at two stacked blank textbooks on a desk.
shots.narration: 普通化学和部分有机化学是前提。

shots.scene: 欣欣摆手，旁边讲台图标被划掉
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its paw; beside it, a small lecture podium icon is crossed out.
shots.narration: 课上不会再停下来讲概念。

shots.scene: 阿杰看操作演示，头顶冒出一串问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student watches the older man pipetting at a bench, with several question marks above his head.
shots.narration: 原理不懂，看操作会一头雾水。

shots.section_title: 课前复习萃取、色谱、蒸馏
shots.scene: 三张空白卡片：分液漏斗、色谱柱、蒸馏装置图标
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards with icons: a separatory funnel, a chromatography column, and a distillation setup. No people.
shots.narration: 萃取、色谱、蒸馏，先复习原理课。
overlay: 课前复习萃取、色谱、蒸馏

shots.section_title: 课前复习萃取、色谱、蒸馏
shots.scene: 小研在书桌前看电脑上的空白课程列表，再看实验台
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student watches a laptop with a blank list on the screen, then glances toward a lab bench.
shots.narration: 复习好了，再来看实际操作。

shots.section_title: 先学基础，再学专门技术
shots.scene: 台阶图标：低台阶是简单烧瓶，高台阶是复杂装置
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon with a small flask on the lower steps and a complex apparatus on the top step. No people.
shots.narration: 先学人人都要会的常用技术。
overlay: 先学基础，再学专门技术

shots.section_title: 先学基础，再学专门技术
shots.scene: 欣欣站在台阶顶端向上指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands on the top of a staircase icon and points upward.
shots.narration: 再学有机实验的专门操作和合成。

shots.scene: 老周穿实验服、戴手套护目镜在实验台前移液，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The older man in a lab coat, gloves and goggles pipettes at a bench, then waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 操作由天天做化学的老周来演示。

shots.scene: 老周在手套箱和通风柜旁工作，阿杰在旁记笔记
shots.prompt_en: The older man works beside a glove box and a fume hood while the young male student takes notes in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 他会把多年经验一并教给你。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现烧瓶、仪器屏幕、问号变灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a flask, an instrument screen and a question mark turning into a light bulb.
shots.narration: 动手做实验，才能真正懂化学。

shots.scene: 两本空白书和三张技术卡片
shots.prompt_en: Two blank textbooks and three cards with a separatory funnel, a column and a distillation setup. No people.
shots.narration: 先懂原理，复习萃取、色谱和蒸馏。

shots.scene: 台阶图标，老周在顶端招手
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon with the older man waving from the top step.
shots.narration: 由浅入深，跟着老周一步步学。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在实验室门口一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera with the young male student and the female graduate student at a lab door, all in lab coats.
shots.narration: 我们一起去学做化学吧！
